data_tooling.name: build-your-own-x
data_tooling.summary: Build-Your-Own-X 是一个精心编排的教程集合，通过从零开始复现各种技术来教授编程，帮助开发者通过动手实践理解系统内部原理。其核心方法是将复杂系统分解为可学习的组件，展示基础概念如何组合成复杂工具的技术思路。你可以用它构建从数据库到游戏的各种项目，在探索常用工具底层原理的同时获得实用技能——这种“边做边学”的方式非常适合想要通过主动创造来深化编程理解的开发者，为技术成长提供了一条清晰的实践路径。
data_tooling.summary_en: Build-Your-Own-X is a curated collection of tutorials that teaches programming by recreating technologies from scratch, helping developers understand system internals through hands-on implementation. Its technical insight lies in breaking down complex systems into learnable components, demonstrating how foundational concepts combine to create sophisticated tools. You can use it to build anything from databases to games, gaining practical skills while exploring how your favorite tools work under the hood—perfect for deepening your programming knowledge through active creation.

data_tooling.name: TabPFN
data_tooling.summary: TabPFN是一个专为表格数据设计的基础模型，在中小规模数据集上表现优于梯度提升等传统方法。其核心技术是“先验数据拟合网络”（PFN），通过在大规模合成数据上预训练，隐式学习贝叶斯后验分布，从而无需调参即可快速生成准确预测。使用时，你只需像调用scikit-learn一样导入模型，即可完成分类、回归和缺失值填充任务。此外，它还能用于少样本学习和不确定性估计，非常适合快速原型验证或数据探索场景。
data_tooling.summary_en: TabPFN is a foundation model for tabular data that outperforms traditional methods like gradient boosting on small-to-medium datasets. It uses a prior-data fitted network (PFN) to learn a Bayesian posterior over model parameters, enabling fast, accurate predictions without hyperparameter tuning. You can use it via scikit-learn API for classification, regression, and imputation, or extend it for few-shot learning and uncertainty estimation.

edge_embedded.name: local-deep-research
edge_embedded.summary: local-deep-research 是一个开源研究框架，让你用本地或云端大模型进行深度、多步骤的调研，在 SimpleQA 上达到约 95% 的准确率。它的核心思路是：通过迭代式查询优化，从 arXiv、PubMed、私人文档等 10 多个来源检索信息，并支持端到端加密，确保数据隐私。技术亮点在于将 LLM 的推理能力与搜索引擎 API 编排成一个自动化的研究流水线。你可以用它来做文献综述、事实核查或个性化知识探索——所有数据都留在本地，安全可控。
edge_embedded.summary_en: local-deep-research is an open-source framework that enables deep, multi-step research using local or cloud LLMs, achieving ~95% on SimpleQA. It combines iterative query refinement with retrieval from 10+ sources (arXiv, PubMed, private docs) and supports encryption for privacy. Technically, it orchestrates LLM calls and search APIs to simulate a research workflow. Use it to conduct automated literature reviews, fact-checking, or personal knowledge discovery—all while keeping data local and encrypted.

ui_devex.name: awesome-ai-apps
ui_devex.summary: 这是一个精选的AI应用项目集合，涵盖RAG、智能代理和工作流等典型用例，为开发者提供实用参考。其核心亮点在于通过模块化设计和MCP（模型上下文协议），实现大语言模型与真实任务的灵活集成。开发者可直接借鉴其中的代码模式，快速搭建聊天机器人、文档分析工具或自动化流水线，并根据自身需求调整组件。无论是想学习AI应用架构，还是寻找可复用的解决方案，这个仓库都能提供丰富的灵感与起点。
ui_devex.summary_en: This curated collection showcases diverse AI applications, including RAG, agents, and workflows, serving as a practical reference for developers. It highlights how modular design and MCP (Model Context Protocol) enable flexible integration of LLMs into real-world tasks. Developers can explore examples to quickly prototype chatbots, document analyzers, or automation pipelines, adapting patterns to their own projects.

ui_devex.name: vscode-dark-islands
ui_devex.summary: Dark Islands 是一款融合了 easemate IDE 与 JetBrains Islands 主题风格的 VSCode 主题。它采用深色平衡色调，在减轻视觉疲劳的同时保持语法高亮的清晰与区分度，优先考虑长时间编码的舒适性与可读性。技术亮点在于对色彩对比度和饱和度的精细调校，使代码结构一目了然。使用时，可直接从 VSCode 市场安装，或克隆仓库后通过设置应用。适合追求精致深色主题、希望获得岛屿般宁静编码体验的开发者。
ui_devex.summary_en: Dark Islands is a VSCode theme blending the aesthetics of the easemate IDE with JetBrains Islands. It offers a dark, balanced palette that reduces eye strain while keeping syntax highlighting clear and distinct. The theme prioritizes readability and visual comfort for long coding sessions. To use it, install from the VSCode marketplace or clone the repo and apply via settings. It's ideal for developers who prefer a refined dark theme with a touch of island-inspired tranquility.

agents_workflows.name: agency-agents
agents_workflows.summary: Agency-agents是一个开源框架，旨在简化多智能体AI系统的构建。它通过提供预配置的专用智能体，解决协调多样化AI能力的复杂性。每个智能体具有独特的个性和处理流程，支持模块化协作，适用于前端开发、内容审核等特定任务。开发者可通过API快速部署智能体，定制现有智能体以适应新领域，或组合它们构建复杂工作流。该框架适用于自动化多步骤、多专业知识项目，鼓励用户创建智能体团队解决实际问题。
agents_workflows.summary_en: Agency-agents is an open-source framework that simplifies building multi-agent AI systems by providing pre-configured specialized agents, addressing the complexity of coordinating diverse AI capabilities. Its key insight is structuring agents with distinct personalities and processes, enabling modular collaboration where each agent handles specific tasks like frontend development or content moderation. Developers can deploy these agents via the provided API, customize existing agents for new domains, or combine them to create complex workflows, making it practical for automating multi-step projects requiring varied expertise.

agents_workflows.name: local-deep-research
agents_workflows.summary: local-deep-research 是一个开源研究框架，让你用本地或云端大模型进行深度、多步骤的调研，在 SimpleQA 上达到约 95% 的准确率。它的核心思路是：通过迭代式查询优化，从 arXiv、PubMed、私人文档等 10 多个来源检索信息，并支持端到端加密，确保数据隐私。技术亮点在于将 LLM 的推理能力与搜索引擎 API 编排成一个自动化的研究流水线。你可以用它来做文献综述、事实核查或个性化知识探索——所有数据都留在本地，安全可控。
agents_workflows.summary_en: local-deep-research is an open-source framework that enables deep, multi-step research using local or cloud LLMs, achieving ~95% on SimpleQA. It combines iterative query refinement with retrieval from 10+ sources (arXiv, PubMed, private docs) and supports encryption for privacy. Technically, it orchestrates LLM calls and search APIs to simulate a research workflow. Use it to conduct automated literature reviews, fact-checking, or personal knowledge discovery—all while keeping data local and encrypted.
